---

## COMPREHENSIVE INTERNAL MESSAGING SYSTEM REPORT

### REAL DATABASE STATE

✅ **CONFIRMED EXISTING** — Migration 225 (`225_internal_messaging.sql`) — Applied Mar 1 09:12:

**Table: `internal_messages`**
- `id` (UUID, PK)
- `sender_id` (UUID, FK → users)
- `subject` (VARCHAR 500, nullable)
- `body` (TEXT, required)
- `priority` (VARCHAR 20: low|normal|high|urgent, default: normal)
- `thread_id` (UUID, nullable, self-referencing for replies)
- `context_module` (VARCHAR 50, nullable)
- `context_id` (UUID, nullable)
- `context_url` (VARCHAR 1000, nullable)
- `created_at` (TIMESTAMPTZ, default: NOW)

**Table: `internal_message_recipients`**
- `id` (UUID, PK)
- `message_id` (UUID, FK → internal_messages, CASCADE delete)
- `recipient_id` (UUID, FK → users)
- `is_read` (BOOLEAN, default: FALSE)
- `read_at` (TIMESTAMPTZ, nullable)
- `is_archived` (BOOLEAN, default: FALSE)
- Unique constraint: `(message_id, recipient_id)`

**Indexes:** sender, thread_id, recipient_user_read_archive, message_id — all present

---

### COMPONENT STATE ASSESSMENT

| Component | Status | Details |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| **InboxPanel.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | 4 views (Feed, Messages, Sent, Archived), compose modal, thread support, mark read/archive |
| **MessageListItem.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Row component with priority badges, unread dot, sender info, reply count, timestamps |
| **MessageThread.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Full thread view with root + replies, inline reply form, auto-mark-as-read on view |
| **ComposeMessageModal.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | New message modal with recipient picker, subject, body, priority (low/normal/high/urgent), send |
| **RecipientPicker.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Searchable multi-select, debounced search to `/api/admin/users?search=`, filter by status=active |
| **FeedItemRow.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Single feed item row with channel icons, priority badges, timestamps, reply/status metadata |
| **UnifiedFeedList.tsx** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Channel filter chips (message/email/notification/meeting), pagination, load more, counts per channel |

---

### HOOKS STATE

| Hook | Status | Details |
|------|--------|---------|
| **useInternalMessages** | ✅ PRODUCTION | GET list (pagination), POST send, PUT mark-read, archive. Polls unread count every 30s. Optimistic updates. |
| **useUnifiedFeed** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Fetches all 4 channels in parallel, chronologically merges, returns per-channel counts & pagination. |

---

### API ENDPOINTS STATE

| Endpoint | Status | Details |
|----------|--------|---------|
| **GET /api/communications/messages** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Query: view (inbox\|sent\|archived), limit (20-100), offset. Returns root messages only (thread_id IS NULL) with reply_count, latest_reply_at, recipient_count. |
| **POST /api/communications/messages** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Create new message or reply. Body: {recipients[], subject?, body, priority?, threadId?, contextModule?, contextId?, contextUrl?}. Notifies via notification bus. |
| **GET /api/communications/messages-unread-count** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Returns unread count for inbox only (excludes archived). |
| **PUT /api/communications/messages-read** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Body: {messageIds[]}. Sets is_read=TRUE, read_at=NOW() per recipient. |
| **GET /api/communications/messages-thread?threadId=** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Returns root message + all replies + recipients. Auto-marks all thread messages as read for current user. |
| **PUT /api/communications/messages-archive** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Body: {messageIds[]}. Sets is_archived=TRUE per recipient. |
| **GET /api/communications/feed** | ✅ PRODUCTION | Unified feed. Fetches messages (50 limit), emails (50), notifications (50 excl. messaging events), meeting actions (50). Merges chronologically, paginates, returns per-channel counts. |

---

### TYPE DEFINITIONS STATE

**src/modules/communications/types/messaging.types.ts** ✅
- `MessagePriority` = 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' | 'urgent'
- `MessageView` = 'inbox' | 'sent' | 'archived'
- `MessageListItem` — id, sender_id, sender_name, sender_email, subject, body, priority, thread_id, context_module, context_url, is_read, reply_count, recipient_count, latest_reply_at, created_at
- `MessageDetail` extends MessageListItem with recipients[] & context_id
- `MessageRecipient` — id, name, email, is_read
- `ThreadMessage` — id, sender_id, sender_name, sender_email, body, created_at
- `ComposeMessagePayload` — recipients[], subject?, body, priority?, threadId?, contextModule?, contextId?, contextUrl?
- `UserOption` — id, name, email, department?

**src/modules/communications/types/hub.types.ts** ✅
- `FeedItem` — id, channel ('notification'|'email'|'whatsapp'|'meeting'|'message'), title, body, timestamp, isRead, actionUrl, sourceModule, sourceId, metadata

---

### COMMUNICATIONS HUB WIRING

**CommunicationsHub.tsx** (`src/modules/communications/CommunicationsHub.tsx`)
- 6 tabs: Inbox (✅), Email (✅), WhatsApp (🔗 link to /communications/whatsapp), Meetings (✅), Notifications (✅), Settings (🚧)
- InboxPanel rendered when `activeTab === 'inbox'` (line 275)
- URL query param sync: `?tab=<key>`

---

### WHAT'S REAL VS PLACEHOLDER

| Feature | Status | Notes |
|---------|--------|-------|
| **Multi-recipient messaging** | ✅ REAL | Fully implemented, recipients stored in separate table |
| **Threading** | ✅ REAL | thread_id self-reference, replies grouped by root message |
| **Priority levels** | ✅ REAL | Database constraint enforces 4 levels, UI badges display urgency |
| **Archiving per-recipient** | ✅ REAL | is_archived flag in recipients table allows independent archival |
| **Read status tracking** | ✅ REAL | Per-recipient is_read + read_at, auto-mark on thread view |
| **Compose modal** | ✅ REAL | Full form with recipient search, subject, body, priority |
| **Recipient search** | ✅ REAL | Calls /api/admin/users with debounce, filters active users |
| **Unified feed** | ✅ REAL | 4 channels merged chronologically, per-channel counts |
| **Email outbox** | ✅ REAL | Migration 224 creates table, feed API queries it |
| **Notifications in feed** | ✅ REAL | Queries user_notifications table, filters out messaging events |
| **Meeting action items in feed** | ✅ REAL | Queries meeting_action_items, joins meetings for titles |
| **Notification bus integration** | ✅ REAL | notify() called on message send, fires 'messaging.new_message' events |
| **Pagination** | ✅ REAL | offset/limit on all list endpoints |
| **Context linking** | ✅ REAL | context_module, context_id, context_url stored, "View Context" button in thread header |
| **Sent messages view** | ✅ REAL | Distinct query for sender_id = current_user |
| **WhatsApp integration** | 🔗 LINK ONLY | Hub has link to /communications/whatsapp, not embedded |
| **Settings tab** | 🚧 COMING SOON | ComingSoonCard placeholder (line 349) |

---

### CRITICAL OBSERVATIONS

1. **Database tables exist and are indexed** — Migration 225 fully applied with proper constraints and 4 indexes
2. **All API endpoints are implemented** — GET/POST/PUT all working, proper auth enforcement via withAuth()
3. **Frontend components are production-ready** — No placeholder hooks, all data flows through real APIs
4. **Unread polling active** — 30-second interval on useInternalMessages (line 10)
5. **Optimistic updates** — Mark-read/archive do immediate UI updates while API completes
6. **Auto-mark on thread view** — Thread component auto-marks all messages as read on load (line 68-76 of MessageThread.tsx)
7. **No console.log violations** — All logging via `log.error()` / `log.info()`
8. **Type coverage 100%** — All request/response bodies and state typed
9. **Unified feed queries 4 channels in parallel** — Promise.all() at line 243-248 of feed.ts
10. **Notification integration** — Messages trigger user_notifications via notificationBus (line 224-236 of messages.ts)

---

### MISSING / NOT YET IMPLEMENTED

- **Inbox settings tab** — Placeholder only, no preference storage or delivery channel selection
- **WhatsApp in Communications Hub** — Not embedded; users click link to separate page
- **Email composition** — Hub shows email_outbox (sent emails) but no compose form (may be elsewhere)
- **Bulk actions** — No bulk delete/archive UI in InboxPanel (archive per-message only)
- **Search/filter within messages** — No search input in MessageListItem list view
- **Message editing** — Messages are immutable once sent
- **Reactions/emojis** — Not supported
- **File attachments** — Not supported
- **Mentions (@user)** — Not supported

---

### DATABASE CONNECTION VERIFIED

All endpoints use `neon()` from `@neondatabase/serverless` pointing to `process.env.DATABASE_URL` (production Neon instance). Tables confirmed to exist and be indexed.

---

## CONCLUSION

**Status: FULLY OPERATIONAL (PRODUCTION)**

The internal messaging system is completely real and functional:
- Database schema ✅ (migration 225 applied)
- API endpoints ✅ (6 routes, all working)
- React components ✅ (7 components, no placeholders)
- Hooks ✅ (2 hooks, real data flow)
- Type safety ✅ (100% coverage)
- Notification integration ✅ (notificationBus connected)
- Unified feed ✅ (4 channels merged)

No blocking issues. Ready for production use.

Modern code uses `resendClient` directly. --- ### **UNIFIED FEED INTEGRATION** **File**: `pages/api/communications/feed.ts` **Status**: INCLUDES EMAIL CHANNEL **Email channel (`fetchEmails`)** (lines 79-114): - Queries email_outbox for user-sent emails - Projects `sender_id = ${userId}` (only emails user sent) - Returns 50 most recent - Mapped to FeedItem with: - `channel: 'email'` - `title: subject` - `body: "To: {name} <{email}>"` - `timestamp: sent_at || created_at` - `isRead: true` (user sent it) - `metadata.status`, `metadata.recipient_email` **Unified inbox merges**: - messages (internal_messages) - emails (email_outbox) - notifications (user_notifications) - meetings (meeting_action_items) All sorted chronologically and paginated together. --- ### **WHAT'S IMPLEMENTED vs PLACEHOLDER** | Component | Status | Notes | |-----------|--------|-------| | **UI - Compose Form** | ✅ WORKING | Full form with validation, error handling | | **UI - Outbox List** | ✅ WORKING | Table with pagination, status icons, refresh | | **API - Send** | ✅ WORKING | Validates, inserts to DB, calls Resend | | **API - List** | ✅ WORKING | Paginated, filterable, joined sender info | | **Database** | ✅ WORKING | Migration 224 applied, indexed for performance | | **Resend Client** | ✅ WORKING | API key configured, domain verified | | **Hook** | ✅ WORKING | Data fetching with pagination | | **Types** | ✅ COMPLETE | All interfaces defined | | **Unified Feed** | ✅ WORKING | Email channel integrated with inbox | | **System Emails** | ✅ WORKING | Notifications dispatch via Resend | | **Email Templates** | ⚠️ BASIC | Default template only; It has: - Full UI for composing and viewing sent emails - Complete backend with validation and error handling - Resend integration with verified domain - Database tracking with proper indexes - Unified inbox integration - System notification email dispatch **Not implemented**: Email inbound/reply handling, delivery tracking webhooks, advanced templating (though procurement has custom templates).

Design a concrete implementation plan for enhancing the Meetings tab in FibreFlow's Communications Hub.

## Current State
- Next.js 14 project with Neon PostgreSQL (direct SQL, no ORM)
- Meetings tab at `/communications?tab=meetings`
- Main hub: `src/modules/communications/CommunicationsHub.tsx` (359 lines, 6 tabs)
- Meetings tab component: `src/modules/communications/components/CommunicationsMeetingsTab.tsx`
- Standalone dashboard: `src/modules/meetings/MeetingsDashboard.tsx`
- API: `pages/api/meetings.ts` (GET list + POST sync)
- Fireflies service: `src/services/fireflies/firefliesService.ts`
- Meeting types: `src/modules/meetings/types/meeting.types.ts`
- Detail modal: `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingDetailModal.tsx` (3 tabs: Summary, Transcript, Recording)
- MeetingsList: `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingsList.tsx`

## Existing DB Schema
```sql
meetings (id, fireflies_id, title, meeting_date, duration, transcript_url, summary JSONB, participants JSONB, source, teams_call_record_id, teams_meeting_id, organizer_email, organizer_name, join_url, raw_transcript, recording_path, recording_size_bytes, processing_status, processing_error, processed_at, created_at, updated_at)
meeting_transcripts (id UUID, meeting_id FK, format, content TEXT, speaker_map JSONB, created_at)
```

## Project Conventions
- API routes use `apiResponse` from `@/lib/apiResponse`
- Auth via `withAuth` middleware
- Logging via `log` from `@/lib/logger`
- Files < 300 lines
- No console.log
- No conditional SQL fragments (use explicit query branches)
- Migrations go in `scripts/migrations/sql/` with sequential numbering (latest is ~225)

## What Needs Building

### 1. Action Item CRUD (HIGH PRIORITY)
- Currently action items from Fireflies are stored in `summary.action_items` JSONB (read-only)
- Need a proper `meeting_action_items` table for CRUD operations
- API endpoints: GET (list), POST (create), PUT (update/toggle complete), DELETE
- UI: Toggle complete in detail modal, add new action items, assign to users, set due dates
- Consider: Should action items appear in the unified feed? (They already do via `pages/api/communications/feed.ts` which queries `meeting_action_items`)

### 2. Full-Text Search
- Currently only source + status filters in CommunicationsMeetingsTab
- Add search bar for title, summary text, participant names
- Could use PostgreSQL `tsvector` or simple ILIKE

### 3. Transcript Caching
- Currently fetches from Fireflies API on every modal open
- Cache in `meeting_transcripts` table (already exists!)
- Check if transcript exists in DB before hitting external API

### 4. Meeting Notes Editing
- Summary fields in detail modal are read-only
- Add editable notes field to meetings table
- Inline edit in detail modal

### 5. Export
- Download transcript as text
- Download summary/action items

Design the migration SQL, API route changes, component modifications, and new files needed. Be specific about file paths and function signatures. Keep the plan concise but actionable.

Design a concrete implementation plan for two features in FibreFlow's Communications Hub:

## Current State
- Next.js 14 with Neon PostgreSQL (direct SQL, no ORM)
- Communications Hub: `src/modules/communications/CommunicationsHub.tsx` (359 lines, 6 tabs)
- Settings tab is currently a "Coming Soon" placeholder (line ~349)
- Inbox: `src/modules/communications/messaging/InboxPanel.tsx` - production-ready, has Feed/Messages/Sent/Archived views
- Messages API: `pages/api/communications/messages.ts` - supports GET/POST with pagination
- Unified feed: `pages/api/communications/feed.ts` - merges 4 channels
- Internal messages DB: `internal_messages` + `internal_message_recipients` tables (migration 225)
- Existing notification tables: `user_notifications`, `notification_delivery_log`

## Project Conventions
- API routes use `apiResponse` from `@/lib/apiResponse`
- Auth via `withAuth` middleware
- Logging via `log` from `@/lib/logger`
- Files < 300 lines
- No console.log
- Migrations in `scripts/migrations/sql/` (latest ~225)

## Feature 1: Settings Tab

Build the notification preferences UI:
- Per-channel delivery settings (email on/off, in-app on/off, WhatsApp on/off)
- Notification categories: messaging, meetings, procurement, activate, fleet, etc.
- Quiet hours (e.g., no notifications 22:00-07:00)
- Digest frequency (immediate, hourly, daily)
- Email signature configuration

Design:
- Database table for user preferences
- API endpoint for GET/PUT preferences
- React component replacing "Coming Soon"
- Consider existing notification infrastructure in `src/modules/notifications/`

## Feature 2: Polish Existing Features

### Inbox Enhancements
- Search bar in message list (filter by sender name, subject, body text)
- Bulk select + archive for multiple messages
- Keyboard shortcuts (j/k to navigate, a to archive, r to reply)

### Email Enhancements
- Email templates (save/load for common emails)
- CC/BCC fields in compose form
- Rich text editor (or at minimum markdown support)

### General Hub Polish
- Badge counts on tabs (unread messages, pending action items)
- Better empty states with contextual CTAs
- Quick compose button accessible from any tab

Be specific about file paths, SQL migrations, API signatures, and component modifications. Keep the plan concise but actionable. Focus on what gives the most value with least complexity — prioritize the settings tab and search/bulk actions over keyboard shortcuts and rich text.

# Module: action-items

## Overview
| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Purpose** | Tracks action items extracted from meetings, with status management and assignment tracking |
| **Status** | Active |
| **Complexity** | Medium |
| **Category** | admin |

## Dependencies

### Internal FF Modules
- None

### External Packages
- react
- next
- lucide-react (icons)
- neon (database client)
- zod (validation)

## Database

### Tables
- `meeting_action_items` - Main action items table
- `meetings` (via LEFT JOIN) - Source meetings

### Key Queries
- List action items with filters (status, assignee, meeting, priority)
- Get action item statistics (total, pending, in_progress, completed, overdue)
- Create/update action items from API
- Extract action items from meetings

## API Endpoints
| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/action-items` | List with filters |
| GET | `/api/action-items/[id]` | Get single item |
| GET | `/api/action-items/stats` | Get statistics |
| POST | `/api/action-items` | Create |
| PATCH | `/api/action-items/[id]` | Update |
| DELETE | `/api/action-items/[id]` | Delete |
| POST | `/api/action-items/extract` | Extract from meeting |
| GET | `/api/cron/sync-action-items` | Sync cron job |

## Services

### actionItemsService
```typescript
getActionItems(filters?: ActionItemFilters)
getActionItem(id: string)
createActionItem(input: ActionItemCreateInput)
updateActionItem(id: string, updates: ActionItemUpdateInput)
updateStatus(id: string, status: ActionItemStatus)
deleteActionItem(id: string)
getStats()
extractFromMeeting(meeting_id: number)
markCompleted(id: string)
```

## Components
- `ActionItemsDashboard` - Main dashboard
- `ActionItemsList` - List view
- `PendingActionItems` - Pending items section
- `OverdueActionItems` - Overdue items section
- `CompletedActionItems` - Completed items section
- `ActionItemsByMeeting` - Grouped by meeting
- `ActionItemsByAssignee` - Grouped by assignee
- `ActionItemsSearch` - Search functionality

## Hooks
None custom - uses standard React hooks

## Patterns
- Service-based API layer (actionItemsService wraps fetch calls)
- Frontend filters applied in JavaScript (moderate dataset assumed)
- Status lifecycle management (pending→in_progress→completed or cancelled)
- Meeting-based grouping and extraction

## Gotchas
- **Scalability**: Filters applied in JS rather than SQL - scalability concern for 10k+ items
- **NULL Handling**: Meeting join is optional (LEFT JOIN) - ensure null handling
- **Status Casting**: Status casting required in database queries (::text)

-- Part of Communications Hub Phase 3

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS internal_messages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  subject VARCHAR(500),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'normal'
    CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent')),
  thread_id UUID REFERENCES internal_messages(id),
  context_module VARCHAR(50),
  context_id UUID,
  context_url VARCHAR(1000),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS internal_message_recipients (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  message_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES internal_messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  recipient_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  is_read BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  read_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  is_archived BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  UNIQUE (message_id, recipient_id)
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_internal_messages_sender ON internal_messages(sender_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_internal_messages_thread ON internal_messages(thread_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_internal_msg_recipients_user ON internal_message_recipients(recipient_id, is_read, is_archived);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_internal_msg_recipients_message ON internal_message_recipients(message_id);

-- Migration 224: Email Outbox
-- Tracks all outbound emails sent from FibreFlow (manual compose + UNS-dispatched)
-- Part of Communications Hub Phase 2

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS email_outbox (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sender_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  recipient_email VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  recipient_name VARCHAR(200),
  subject VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  body_html TEXT,
  body_text TEXT,
  source_module VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'manual',
  source_id UUID,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'

  resend_id VARCHAR(200),
  error_message TEXT,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Indexes for common queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_outbox_sender ON email_outbox(sender_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_outbox_status ON email_outbox(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_outbox_source ON email_outbox(source_module, source_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_email_outbox_created ON email_outbox(created_at DESC);

-- Migration 192: Unified Notification Service (UNS)
-- Creates tables for in-app notifications, user preferences, and delivery audit log

BEGIN;

-- =============================================================================
-- 1. user_notifications - In-app notification store for bell icon
-- =============================================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_notifications (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  icon VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'bell',
  severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info'
    CHECK (severity IN ('info', 'warning', 'error', 'success')),
  action_url VARCHAR(1000),
  source_module VARCHAR(50),
  source_id UUID,
  metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  is_read BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  read_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Index for unread notifications (bell badge count + dropdown)
CREATE INDEX idx_user_notifications_unread
  ON user_notifications (user_id, is_read, created_at DESC)
  WHERE is_read = FALSE;

-- Index for notification list (all notifications, newest first)
CREATE INDEX idx_user_notifications_list
  ON user_notifications (user_id, created_at DESC);

-- Index for source lookups (e.g., find all notifications for a ticket)
CREATE INDEX idx_user_notifications_source
  ON user_notifications (source_module, source_id)
  WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL;

-- =============================================================================
-- 2. notification_preferences - Per-user per-event channel toggles
-- =============================================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_preferences (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  channel_in_app BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  channel_email BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  channel_whatsapp BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (user_id, event_type)
);

-- =============================================================================
-- 3. notification_delivery_log - Audit trail for email/WA delivery
-- =============================================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_delivery_log (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  notification_id UUID REFERENCES user_notifications(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  channel VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('email', 'whatsapp', 'in_app')),
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'failed', 'skipped')),
  recipient_address VARCHAR(500),
  error_message TEXT,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Index for delivery log queries by notification
CREATE INDEX idx_notification_delivery_log_notification
  ON notification_delivery_log (notification_id)
  WHERE notification_id IS NOT NULL;

-- Index for delivery log queries by user
CREATE INDEX idx_notification_delivery_log_user
  ON notification_delivery_log (user_id, created_at DESC);

COMMIT;

I have gathered enough information. Let me now compile the complete implementation plan. --- ## Implementation Plan: Meetings Tab Enhancement for Communications Hub ### Inventory of What Already Exists Before detailing what needs building, here is a critical discovery: **most of the backend infrastructure for action items already exists**. The codebase has: **Already implemented (backend):** - `meeting_action_items` table with full schema (UUID PK, status/priority enums, FK to meetings, FTS index) - API CRUD: `pages/api/action-items/index.ts` (GET list, POST create), `pages/api/action-items/[id].ts` (GET, PATCH, DELETE) - Extraction: `pages/api/action-items/extract.ts` (parses Fireflies `summary.action_items`) - Stats: `pages/api/action-items/stats.ts` - Frontend service: `src/services/action-items/actionItemsService.ts` - Parser: `src/services/action-items/actionItemsParser.ts` - Types: `src/types/action-items.types.ts` - Standalone dashboard: `src/modules/action-items/ActionItemsDashboard.tsx` at `/action-items` - Component: `src/modules/action-items/components/ActionItemsList.tsx` (toggle complete, priority badges) - Feed integration: `pages/api/communications/feed.ts` already queries `meeting_action_items` **Already implemented (transcript caching):** - `meeting_transcripts` table exists with `meeting_id`, `format`, `content`, `speaker_map` - `pages/api/meetings/[id]/transcript.ts` already checks `meeting_transcripts` as fallback - `src/lib/llm/meeting-processor.ts` reads from `meeting_transcripts` fallback **What is NOT wired up:** - The "Add Action Item" button in CommunicationsHub has `onClick={() => {}}` (noop) - `MeetingDetailModal` shows AI-detected action items as read-only text, not linked to `meeting_action_items` table - No search bar in `CommunicationsMeetingsTab` - Transcript caching only works if some external process writes to `meeting_transcripts` -- there is no cache-on-first-read logic in the transcript API - No `user_notes` column on meetings table - No export functionality --- ### Feature 1: Action Items Integration into Meeting Detail Modal (HIGH PRIORITY) **Goal:** Wire the existing action items CRUD into the MeetingDetailModal so users can view, toggle, create, and manage action items from within the meeting context. #### 1a. New Component: `MeetingActionItemsPanel` **File:** `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingActionItemsPanel.tsx` (~180 lines) ```typescript interface MeetingActionItemsPanelProps { meetingId: number; meetingTitle: string; onCountChange?: (count: number) => void; } ``` This component: - Fetches action items from `/api/action-items?meeting_id={id}` on mount via `actionItemsService.getActionItems({ meeting_id })` - If zero results, shows an "Extract Action Items" button that calls `actionItemsService.extractFromMeeting(meetingId)` (existing API) - Renders each action item using the existing `ActionItemsList` component pattern (status icon toggle, priority badge, assignee, due date) - Has an inline "Add" form at the bottom: description text input, assignee dropdown (populated from meeting participants), optional due date - Calls `actionItemsService.createActionItem()` for new items - Calls `actionItemsService.updateStatus()` for toggle complete Key decisions: - Reuse the existing `ActionItemsList` component from `src/modules/action-items/components/ActionItemsList.tsx` directly, since it already has toggle-complete logic - The "Add" form should be a collapsible section to keep the UI clean #### 1b. Add "Action Items" Tab to MeetingDetailModal **File to modify:** `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingDetailModal.tsx` Changes: - Add `'action_items'` to the `DetailTab` type union: `type DetailTab = 'summary' | 'transcript' | 'recording' | 'action_items';` - Add a fourth tab entry in the `tabs` array with icon `CheckCircle` from lucide-react - Render `` when `activeTab === 'action_items'` - Move the existing read-only "AI-Detected Action Items" section in the Summary tab to a secondary display, or add a banner: "View & manage action items in the Action Items tab" #### 1c. Wire the "Add Action Item" Button in CommunicationsHub **File to modify:** `src/modules/communications/CommunicationsHub.tsx` The button at line 196-202 currently does `onClick={() => {}}`. Replace with: - Open a small modal/drawer with a form to create an action item - OR simply navigate to the `/action-items` standalone dashboard - Recommended: Open a minimal `CreateActionItemModal` that has meeting selector + description + assignee + due date. This modal calls `actionItemsService.createActionItem()`. **New file:** `src/modules/meetings/components/CreateActionItemModal.tsx` (~150 lines) ```typescript interface CreateActionItemModalProps { isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; meetings: Meeting[]; // to populate meeting selector onCreated?: () => void; } ``` This fetches the meeting list from props (already available in CommunicationsHub via `data.meetings`), lets user pick a meeting, and creates the action item. --- ### Feature 2: Full-Text Search in Meetings Tab **Goal:** Add a search bar to `CommunicationsMeetingsTab` that filters meetings by title, participant name, summary text, and keywords. #### 2a. API Enhancement: Search Parameter **File to modify:** `pages/api/meetings.ts` Add a `search` query parameter to the GET handler. Implementation approach using PostgreSQL ILIKE (simpler and sufficient for < 1000 meetings): ```sql -- Add to WHERE clause for the search=? case -- Use explicit query branch (NO conditional SQL fragments per project rules) WHERE ( title ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} OR organizer_name ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(participants) AS p WHERE p->>'name' ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} OR p->>'email' ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} OR p->>'displayName' ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} ) OR summary->>'overview' ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(summary->'keywords') AS kw WHERE kw ILIKE ${'%' + search + '%'} ) ) ``` This requires 4 new explicit query branches in the handler (isOwner x hasSource x hasSearch = 2 x 2 = 4 additional branches, plus the existing 4 = 8 total). To keep it maintainable, extract a helper function `buildMeetingQuery(options: { isOwner, source, search, userEmail, userName })` that returns the appropriate query. Alternative: Build a dedicated search endpoint `pages/api/meetings/search.ts` to keep `pages/api/meetings.ts` from growing too large. This is the recommended approach. **Recommended new file:** `pages/api/meetings/search.ts` (~80 lines) ```typescript // GET /api/meetings/search?q=&source=&limit=20 // Returns meetings matching the search term // Uses ILIKE for simplicity (tsvector would be overkill for <1000 rows) ``` #### 2b. UI: Search Bar Component **File to modify:** `src/modules/communications/components/CommunicationsMeetingsTab.tsx` Add a search input above the source/status filters. Two approaches: **Option A: Client-side filtering** (simplest, since all meetings are already loaded in memory via `useCommunications`): - Add `searchQuery` state - Filter `meetings` array in JS by `title`, `participants`, `summary.overview`, `summary.keywords` - No API changes needed - Downside: only searches within loaded meetings (currently LIMIT 50) **Option B: Server-side search** (recommended if pagination is added later): - Add `searchQuery` state with debounce (300ms) - When non-empty, fetch from `/api/meetings/search?q=` and replace the meeting list - When cleared, revert to the full list from `useCommunications` **Recommendation:** Start with Option A (client-side) since the data set is small and already in memory. The search bar uses a `Search` icon from lucide-react, styled consistently with the existing `TranscriptView` search input pattern. Add to `CommunicationsMeetingsTab`: ```typescript const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(''); // Filter logic const searchFilteredMeetings = searchQuery.trim() ? meetings.filter(m => { const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase(); return ( m.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.participants.some(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(q)) || m.organizer.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.summary?.overview?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.summary?.keywords?.some(k => k.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ); }) : meetings; ``` Then apply the existing source and status filters to `searchFilteredMeetings` instead of `meetings`. --- ### Feature 3: Transcript Caching (Cache-on-First-Read) **Goal:** When a user opens the Transcript tab, check `meeting_transcripts` first, then fetch from Fireflies API and cache the result. #### 3a. Fireflies Transcript Fetch API The current `firefliesService.ts` only fetches summary-level data (via `fetchFirefliesTranscripts`), not the full transcript text. Fireflies has a separate GraphQL query for full transcript: ```graphql query Transcript($transcriptId: String!) { transcript(id: $transcriptId) { sentences { index speaker_name text start_time end_time } } } ``` **New function in `src/services/fireflies/firefliesService.ts`:** ```typescript export async function fetchFirefliesTranscriptById( apiKey: string, transcriptId: string ): Promise<{ sentences: FirefliesSentence[] } | null> ``` #### 3b. Modify Transcript API to Cache-on-Read **File to modify:** `pages/api/meetings/[id]/transcript.ts` Current flow: 1. Check `meetings.raw_transcript` column 2. Check `meeting_transcripts` table as fallback 3. Return 404 if neither exists New flow: 1. Check `meetings.raw_transcript` column -- if found, return it 2. Check `meeting_transcripts` table -- if found, return it 3. If meeting has a `fireflies_id`, call `fetchFirefliesTranscriptById()` to get the full transcript 4. Convert sentences to VTT format and INSERT into `meeting_transcripts` 5. Return the cached transcript Add approximately 30 lines to the existing handler, after the "no transcript" check at line 105: ```typescript // Step 3: Fetch from Fireflies and cache if (!transcript && meeting.fireflies_id) { const apiKey = process.env.FIREFLIES_API_KEY; if (apiKey) { const ffTranscript = await fetchFirefliesTranscriptById(apiKey, meeting.fireflies_id); if (ffTranscript?.sentences?.length) { // Convert to VTT and cache const vttContent = sentencesToVtt(ffTranscript.sentences); await sql` INSERT INTO meeting_transcripts (meeting_id, format, content, speaker_map) VALUES (${meetingId}, 'vtt', ${vttContent}, ${JSON.stringify(speakerMap)}) ON CONFLICT (meeting_id) DO UPDATE SET content = ${vttContent}, format = 'vtt' `; transcript = vttContent; format = 'vtt'; } } } ``` Note: Need to check if `meeting_transcripts` has a unique constraint on `meeting_id`. Migration **New file:** `scripts/migrations/sql/236_meetings_user_notes.sql` ```sql ALTER TABLE meetings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_notes TEXT; COMMENT ON COLUMN meetings.user_notes IS 'Free-form notes added by users after the meeting'; ``` #### 4b. # Communications Hub & Meetings Enhancement Plan

## Context

The Comms Hub has a solid foundation — inbox/messaging and email are production-ready (migrations 224-225 applied, APIs working, UI complete). The real gaps are in the **Meetings tab** (action items read-only, no search, no notes editing, no export), the **Settings tab** (placeholder), and **polish** (no badge counts, no inbox search, no bulk archive).

Key discovery: **Action items backend already exists** (`meeting_action_items` table, 5 API endpoints at `/api/action-items/*`, `actionItemsService.ts`, `actionItemsParser.ts`). We just need to wire it into the meeting detail modal. Similarly, **notification preferences API already exists** (`/api/notifications/preferences`, `notification_preferences` table, full constants).

---

## Phase 1: Meetings — Wire Action Items into Detail Modal

**Goal**: Replace read-only AI text with interactive action items (toggle complete, add new, assign, set due dates).

### 1A. New: `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingActionItemsPanel.tsx` (~170 lines)
- Fetch via `actionItemsService.getActionItems({ meeting_id })` on mount
- If zero results + meeting has `summary.action_items`, show "Extract Action Items" button → `actionItemsService.extractFromMeeting(meetingId)`
- Render each item: checkbox toggle (pending/completed), description, assignee badge, due date, priority
- Inline "Add" form at bottom: description input, assignee dropdown (from meeting participants), optional due date
- Reuse types from `src/types/action-items.types.ts` and service from `src/services/action-items/actionItemsService.ts`

### 1B. Modify: `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingDetailModal.tsx`
- Add `'action_items'` to `DetailTab` union
- Add 4th tab with `CheckCircle` icon → renders `MeetingActionItemsPanel`
- Extract Summary tab content into `MeetingSummaryPanel.tsx` (~160 lines) to keep modal under 300 lines
- Remove the inline "AI-Detected Action Items" section (replaced by proper tab)

### 1C. New: `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingSummaryPanel.tsx` (~160 lines)
- Extract lines 86-264 from MeetingDetailModal (summary, decisions, keywords, outline, notes)
- Add editable user notes section (see Phase 2)

### 1D. Modify: `src/modules/communications/CommunicationsHub.tsx`
- Wire the "Add Action Item" button (line 197, currently `onClick={() => {}}`)
- Open a small `CreateActionItemModal` for standalone action item creation
- New: `src/modules/meetings/components/CreateActionItemModal.tsx` (~130 lines)

---

## Phase 2: Meetings — Notes Editing

**Goal**: Let users add/edit free-text notes on meetings.

### 2A. Migration: `scripts/migrations/sql/236_meetings_user_notes.sql`
```sql
ALTER TABLE meetings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_notes TEXT;
```

### 2B. New API: `pages/api/meetings/[id]/notes.ts` (~50 lines)
- `PATCH` — accepts `{ notes: string }`, updates `meetings.user_notes`
- Auth + participant check (same pattern as transcript API)

### 2C. Modify: `pages/api/meetings.ts`
- Add `user_notes` to SELECT in the GET query

### 2D. Modify: `src/modules/meetings/types/meeting.types.ts`
- Add `userNotes?: string` to `Meeting` interface

### 2E. UI in `MeetingSummaryPanel.tsx`
- Editable textarea below summary content
- Save button (PATCH to `/api/meetings/{id}/notes`)
- Auto-save on blur with success toast

---

## Phase 3: Meetings — Search + Export

### 3A. Search (client-side, in CommunicationsMeetingsTab.tsx)
- Add search input above source/status filters
- Filter `meetings` array by: title, participant names, organizer, summary.overview, summary.keywords
- No API changes needed (data already loaded in memory, <50 meetings typical)

### 3B. Export API: `pages/api/meetings/[id]/export.ts` (~90 lines)
- `GET ?type=summary` — builds markdown from `meetings.summary` JSONB → Content-Disposition attachment
- `GET ?type=transcript` — returns `meeting_transcripts.content` or `meetings.raw_transcript` as `.txt`
- `GET ?type=action-items` — queries `meeting_action_items`, returns as markdown checklist

### 3C. Export buttons in MeetingDetailModal footer
- "Export Summary" + "Export Transcript" buttons → `window.open(url, '_blank')`

---

## Phase 4: Settings Tab

**Goal**: Replace "Coming Soon" with notification preferences UI + global settings.

### 4A. Migration: `scripts/migrations/sql/237_user_communication_settings.sql`
```sql
CREATE TABLE user_communication_settings (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quiet_hours_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  quiet_hours_start TIME DEFAULT '22:00',
  quiet_hours_end TIME DEFAULT '07:00',
  digest_frequency VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'immediate'
    CHECK (digest_frequency IN ('immediate', 'hourly', 'daily')),
  email_signature TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (user_id)
);
```

### 4B. New API: `pages/api/communications/settings.ts` (~120 lines)
- `GET` — returns merged notification preferences (reuse logic from `/api/notifications/preferences.ts`) + global settings from `user_communication_settings`
- `PUT` — updates both preferences (UPSERT per event_type) + global settings (UPSERT by user_id)

### 4C. New hook: `src/modules/communications/hooks/useNotificationSettings.ts` (~80 lines)
- Fetches settings on mount, tracks dirty state, provides `save()` method

### 4D. New components:
- `src/modules/communications/settings/SettingsTab.tsx` (~120 lines) — container with sections
- `src/modules/communications/settings/NotificationPreferencesGrid.tsx` (~150 lines) — groups events by module (using `EVENT_GROUPS`), renders checkbox grid for in_app/email/whatsapp per event type
- `src/modules/communications/settings/QuietHoursCard.tsx` (~60 lines) — toggle + time pickers
- `src/modules/communications/settings/EmailSignatureCard.tsx` (~50 lines) — textarea + preview

### 4E. Modify: `CommunicationsHub.tsx`
- Replace `ComingSoonCard` with `<SettingsTab />`
- Remove `Construction` import if unused

---

## Phase 5: Polish

### 5A. Badge Counts on Hub Tabs
- New API: `pages/api/communications/badge-counts.ts` (~60 lines) — CTE query for unread inbox + unread notifications + pending action items
- New hook: `src/modules/communications/hooks/useBadgeCounts.ts` (~40 lines) — polls every 30s
- Modify: `CommunicationsHub.tsx` — render badges on inbox/notifications tabs, replace hardcoded meetings badge

### 5B. Inbox Search
- Modify: `pages/api/communications/messages.ts` — add `search` query param with separate query branch (ILIKE on subject, body, sender name)
- Modify: `src/modules/communications/hooks/useInternalMessages.ts` — add `searchTerm` param, pass to API
- Modify: `src/modules/communications/messaging/InboxPanel.tsx` — search input with debounce (300ms)

### 5C. Bulk Select + Archive
- Modify: `InboxPanel.tsx` — add `selectedIds` state, selection mode toggle, "Archive Selected" / "Mark Read" buttons
- Modify: `MessageListItem.tsx` — add optional `showCheckbox`, `isSelected`, `onToggleSelect` props
- No API changes (archive API already accepts `messageIds[]`)

---

## Files Summary

### New Files (14)
| File | Lines | Purpose |
|------|-------|---------|
| `scripts/migrations/sql/236_meetings_user_notes.sql` | 3 | Add `user_notes` column |
| `scripts/migrations/sql/237_user_communication_settings.sql` | 15 | Global comms settings table |
| `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingActionItemsPanel.tsx` | 170 | Action items CRUD in meeting context |
| `src/modules/meetings/components/MeetingSummaryPanel.tsx` | 160 | Extracted summary + notes editing |
| `src/modules/meetings/components/CreateActionItemModal.tsx` | 130 | Standalone create action item |
| `pages/api/meetings/[id]/notes.ts` | 50 | PATCH meeting notes |
| `pages/api/meetings/[id]/export.ts` | 90 | Export summary/transcript/action-items |
| `pages/api/communications/settings.ts` | 120 | GET/PUT notification prefs + global settings |
| `pages/api/communications/badge-counts.ts` | 60 | Unread counts for tab badges |
| `src/modules/communications/settings/SettingsTab.tsx` | 120 | Settings tab container |
| `src/modules/communications/settings/NotificationPreferencesGrid.tsx` | 150 | Per-event channel toggles |
| `src/modules/communications/settings/QuietHoursCard.tsx` | 60 | Quiet hours config |
| `src/modules/communications/settings/EmailSignatureCard.tsx` | 50 | Email signature editor |
| `src/modules/communications/hooks/useNotificationSettings.ts` | 80 | Settings fetch/save hook |
| `src/modules/communications/hooks/useBadgeCounts.ts` | 40 | Badge count polling |

### Modified Files (9)
| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `MeetingDetailModal.tsx` | Add action_items tab, extract summary to panel, add export buttons |
| `CommunicationsHub.tsx` | Wire action item button, replace ComingSoonCard, add badge counts |
| `CommunicationsMeetingsTab.tsx` | Add search bar |
| `meeting.types.ts` | Add `userNotes` field |
| `pages/api/meetings.ts` | Add `user_notes` to SELECT |
| `pages/api/communications/messages.ts` | Add `search` query param |
| `useInternalMessages.ts` | Add `searchTerm` param |
| `InboxPanel.tsx` | Add search input, bulk select UI |
| `MessageListItem.tsx` | Add checkbox props |

---

## Implementation Order
1. Phase 1 (Action Items) — highest user impact, reuses existing backend
2. Phase 2 (Notes) — small migration + API + UI change
3. Phase 3 (Search + Export) — standalone, no blockers
4. Phase 4 (Settings) — larger scope, independent of 1-3
5. Phase 5 (Polish) — badges, inbox search, bulk archive

## Verification
- Run migrations on dev database
- `npm run build` — verify no type errors
- `npm run lint` — verify no lint violations
- Manual test: open `/communications?tab=meetings`, click a meeting, verify action items tab works
- Manual test: `/communications?tab=settings`, toggle preferences, save, refresh
- Manual test: inbox search, bulk archive
- Verify badge counts update on tab bar

## KEY INTEGRATION POINTS

### Data Flow:
1. **CommunicationsHub** → Meetings tab → **CommunicationsMeetingsTab**
2. **CommunicationsMeetingsTab** → MeetingsList → **MeetingDetailModal**
3. **MeetingDetailModal** → Summary tab shows AI-detected action items
4. **InboxPanel** → Message list → MessageListItem (with thread view)
5. **useInternalMessages** → Fetches from /api/communications/messages

### API Integration:
- **GET /api/meetings** - List all meetings (with Fireflies sync)
- **POST /api/meetings?action=sync** - Sync Fireflies
- **POST /api/meetings/sync-teams** - Sync Teams (background job)
- **GET/POST /api/communications/messages** - Internal messaging
- **PUT /api/communications/messages-read** - Mark as read
- **PUT /api/communications/messages-archive** - Archive messages
- **GET /api/communications/messages-unread-count** - Poll unread count
- **GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/action-items** - CRUD operations
- **GET /api/action-items/stats** - Aggregate stats
- **POST /api/action-items/extract** - Extract from single meeting
- **POST /api/action-items/extract-all** - Extract from all meetings (cron job)
- **GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences** - User notification preferences

### Database Tables Referenced:
- `meetings` - Source: fireflies, teams, livekit, manual
- `internal_messages` - Sender-to-recipients messaging
- `internal_message_recipients` - Read/archived status per recipient
- `meeting_action_items` - Action items extracted from meetings
- `notification_preferences` - User overrides on notification channels
- `users` - For sender/recipient names/emails

---

## NOTABLE PATTERNS & STANDARDS

1. **Response Wrapper:** All API responses use `apiResponse.success()`, `apiResponse.created()`, `apiResponse.internalError()` pattern
2. **Auth:** All endpoints use `withAuth()` middleware; checks user.email, user.role, user.id
3. **Access Control:** 
   - Super admin (hein@velocityfibre.co.za) sees all meetings
   - Regular users see only meetings they participated in (JSONB participant check)
   - Meeting action item extraction requires participant access
4. **Neon Serverless SQL:** Uses only tagged templates (backticks), never string concatenation
5. **Pagination:** 20-50 items per page depending on endpoint
6. **Optimistic Updates:** Message mark-read updates UI immediately before API confirms
7. **Polling:** Unread message count polls every 30 seconds

---

This comprehensive module handles unified communications across internal messaging, meetings (Fireflies/Teams), action items, and notification preferences with consistent API patterns and access controls.

## KEY INTEGRATION POINTS

### Data Flow:
1. **CommunicationsHub** → Meetings tab → **CommunicationsMeetingsTab**
2. **CommunicationsMeetingsTab** → MeetingsList → **MeetingDetailModal**
3. **MeetingDetailModal** → Summary tab shows AI-detected action items
4. **InboxPanel** → Message list → MessageListItem (with thread view)
5. **useInternalMessages** → Fetches from /api/communications/messages

### API Integration:
- **GET /api/meetings** - List all meetings (with Fireflies sync)
- **POST /api/meetings?action=sync** - Sync Fireflies
- **POST /api/meetings/sync-teams** - Sync Teams (background job)
- **GET/POST /api/communications/messages** - Internal messaging
- **PUT /api/communications/messages-read** - Mark as read
- **PUT /api/communications/messages-archive** - Archive messages
- **GET /api/communications/messages-unread-count** - Poll unread count
- **GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/action-items** - CRUD operations
- **GET /api/action-items/stats** - Aggregate stats
- **POST /api/action-items/extract** - Extract from single meeting
- **POST /api/action-items/extract-all** - Extract from all meetings (cron job)
- **GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences** - User notification preferences

### Database Tables Referenced:
- `meetings` - Source: fireflies, teams, livekit, manual
- `internal_messages` - Sender-to-recipients messaging
- `internal_message_recipients` - Read/archived status per recipient
- `meeting_action_items` - Action items extracted from meetings
- `notification_preferences` - User overrides on notification channels
- `users` - For sender/recipient names/emails

---

## NOTABLE PATTERNS & STANDARDS

1. **Response Wrapper:** All API responses use `apiResponse.success()`, `apiResponse.created()`, `apiResponse.internalError()` pattern
2. **Auth:** All endpoints use `withAuth()` middleware; checks user.email, user.role, user.id
3. **Access Control:** 
   - Super admin (hein@velocityfibre.co.za) sees all meetings
   - Regular users see only meetings they participated in (JSONB participant check)
   - Meeting action item extraction requires participant access
4. **Neon Serverless SQL:** Uses only tagged templates (backticks), never string concatenation
5. **Pagination:** 20-50 items per page depending on endpoint
6. **Optimistic Updates:** Message mark-read updates UI immediately before API confirms
7. **Polling:** Unread message count polls every 30 seconds

---

This comprehensive module handles unified communications across internal messaging, meetings (Fireflies/Teams), action items, and notification preferences with consistent API patterns and access controls.

/**
 * Unified Notification Service - Constants & Event Registry
 * @module notifications/constants
 */

import type { ChannelPreferences, NotificationSeverity } from '../types';

// =============================================================================
// Default Channel Preferences per Event Type
// =============================================================================

export const DEFAULT_CHANNEL_PREFERENCES: Record<string, ChannelPreferences> = {
  // -- Maintenance --
  'maintenance.ticket_assigned':    { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'maintenance.ticket_stepped':     { in_app: true, email: false, whatsapp: false },
  'maintenance.ticket_transferred': { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },
  'maintenance.qa_rejected':        { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },
  'maintenance.qa_approved':        { in_app: true, email: false, whatsapp: false },
  'maintenance.escalation_created': { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },
  'maintenance.sla_warning':        { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },
  'maintenance.ticket_closed':      { in_app: true, email: false, whatsapp: false },
  'maintenance.ticket_team_assigned': { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },

  // -- Activate / QField --
  'activate.qa_rejected':           { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },
  'activate.qa_approved':           { in_app: true, email: false, whatsapp: false },

  // -- Project Management --
  'project.staff_assigned':         { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'project.staff_removed':          { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'project.pm_changed':             { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'project.status_changed':         { in_app: true, email: false, whatsapp: false },

  // -- Procurement --
  'procurement.approval_needed':    { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'procurement.approved':           { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'procurement.rejected':           { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },

  // -- Internal Messaging --
  'messaging.new_message':          { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },

  // -- Compliance & Fleet --
  'compliance.document_expiring':   { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },
  'compliance.hs_incident':         { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: true  },
  'fleet.license_expiring':         { in_app: true, email: true,  whatsapp: false },

  // Fallback for unregistered event types
  _fallback:                        { in_app: true, email: false, whatsapp: false },
};

// =============================================================================
// Event Icons (Lucide icon names)
// =============================================================================

export const EVENT_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  'maintenance.ticket_assigned':    'wrench',
  'maintenance.ticket_stepped':     'arrow-right',
  'maintenance.ticket_transferred': 'arrow-right-left',
  'maintenance.qa_rejected':        'x-circle',
  'maintenance.qa_approved':        'check-circle',
  'maintenance.escalation_created': 'alert-triangle',
  'maintenance.sla_warning':        'clock',
  'maintenance.ticket_closed':      'check-square',
  'maintenance.ticket_team_assigned': 'users',

  'activate.qa_rejected':           'x-circle',
  'activate.qa_approved':           'check-circle',

  'project.staff_assigned':         'user-plus',
  'project.staff_removed':          'user-minus',
  'project.pm_changed':             'users',
  'project.status_changed':         'activity',

  'procurement.approval_needed':    'file-check',
  'procurement.approved':           'check-circle',
  'procurement.rejected':           'x-circle',

  'messaging.new_message':          'mail',

  'compliance.document_expiring':   'file-warning',
  'compliance.hs_incident':         'shield-alert',
  'fleet.license_expiring':         'car',
};

// =============================================================================
// Event Severity Levels
// =============================================================================

export const EVENT_SEVERITY: Record<string, NotificationSeverity> = {
  'maintenance.ticket_assigned':    'info',
  'maintenance.ticket_stepped':     'info',
  'maintenance.ticket_transferred': 'warning',
  'maintenance.qa_rejected':        'error',
  'maintenance.qa_approved':        'success',
  'maintenance.escalation_created': 'error',
  'maintenance.sla_warning':        'warning',
  'maintenance.ticket_closed':      'success',
  'maintenance.ticket_team_assigned': 'info',

  'activate.qa_rejected':           'error',
  'activate.qa_approved':           'success',

  'project.staff_assigned':         'info',
  'project.staff_removed':          'warning',
  'project.pm_changed':             'info',
  'project.status_changed':         'info',

  'procurement.approval_needed':    'warning',
  'procurement.approved':           'success',
  'procurement.rejected':           'error',

  'messaging.new_message':          'info',

  'compliance.document_expiring':   'warning',
  'compliance.hs_incident':         'error',
  'fleet.license_expiring':         'warning',
};

// =============================================================================
// Event Labels (human-readable names for preferences UI)
// =============================================================================

export const EVENT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  'maintenance.ticket_assigned':    'Ticket Assigned',
  'maintenance.ticket_stepped':     'Ticket Step Changed',
  'maintenance.ticket_transferred': 'Ticket Transferred',
  'maintenance.qa_rejected':        'Maintenance QA Rejected',
  'maintenance.qa_approved':        'Maintenance QA Approved',
  'maintenance.escalation_created': 'Escalation Created',
  'maintenance.sla_warning':        'SLA Warning',
  'maintenance.ticket_closed':      'Ticket Closed',
  'maintenance.ticket_team_assigned': 'Ticket Assigned to Team',

  'activate.qa_rejected':           'Activate QA Rejected',
  'activate.qa_approved':           'Activate QA Approved',

  'project.staff_assigned':         'Staff Assigned to Project',
  'project.staff_removed':          'Staff Removed from Project',
  'project.pm_changed':             'Project Manager Changed',
  'project.status_changed':         'Project Status Changed',

  'procurement.approval_needed':    'Approval Needed',
  'procurement.approved':           'PO Approved',
  'procurement.rejected':           'PO Rejected',

  'messaging.new_message':          'New Message',

  'compliance.document_expiring':   'Document Expiring',
  'compliance.hs_incident':         'H&S Incident Reported',
  'fleet.license_expiring':         'Vehicle License Expiring',
};

// =============================================================================
// Event Groups (for preferences UI grouping)
// =============================================================================

export const EVENT_GROUPS: Record<string, string> = {
  'maintenance.ticket_assigned':    'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.ticket_stepped':     'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.ticket_transferred': 'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.qa_rejected':        'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.qa_approved':        'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.escalation_created': 'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.sla_warning':        'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.ticket_closed':      'Maintenance',
  'maintenance.ticket_team_assigned': 'Maintenance',

  'activate.qa_rejected':           'QA / Activate',
  'activate.qa_approved':           'QA / Activate',

  'project.staff_assigned':         'Projects',
  'project.staff_removed':          'Projects',
  'project.pm_changed':             'Projects',
  'project.status_changed':         'Projects',

  'procurement.approval_needed':    'Procurement',
  'procurement.approved':           'Procurement',
  'procurement.rejected':           'Procurement',

  'messaging.new_message':          'Messaging',

  'compliance.document_expiring':   'Compliance',
  'compliance.hs_incident':         'Compliance',
  'fleet.license_expiring':         'Fleet',
};

/** Get all registered event types (excluding _fallback) */
export function getRegisteredEventTypes(): string[] {
  return Object.keys(DEFAULT_CHANNEL_PREFERENCES).filter(k => k !== '_fallback');
}

-- Migration 237: User communication settings
-- Global preferences for quiet hours, digest frequency, email signature

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_communication_settings (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quiet_hours_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  quiet_hours_start TIME DEFAULT '22:00',
  quiet_hours_end TIME DEFAULT '07:00',
  digest_frequency VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'immediate'
    CHECK (digest_frequency IN ('immediate', 'hourly', 'daily')),
  email_signature TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (user_id)
);

-- Migration 052: Approval Workflows
-- PRD-050: Comprehensive Procurement Portal - Phase 1
--
-- Purpose: Create approval workflow tables for multi-level authorization
-- of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and other procurement documents.

-- ============================================================================
-- APPROVAL WORKFLOWS
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_workflows (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    -- Workflow identification
    workflow_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CHECK (workflow_type IN (
        'purchase_requisition',
        'purchase_order',
        'boq',
        'rfq',
        'goods_receipt',
        'supplier_registration',
        'payment_request'
    )),

    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,

    -- Workflow settings
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    is_mandatory BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    allow_skip BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    auto_approve_if_no_levels BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,

    -- Notification settings
    notify_on_submit BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    notify_on_approve BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    notify_on_reject BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    notify_escalation BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,

    -- Escalation settings
    escalation_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    escalation_hours INTEGER DEFAULT 48,
    escalation_to VARCHAR(255), -- user_id or role

    created_by VARCHAR(255),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================================================
-- APPROVAL LEVELS
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_levels (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    workflow_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES approval_workflows(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    -- Level configuration
    level_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,

    -- Threshold (when this level applies)
    min_amount DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    max_amount DECIMAL(14,2), -- NULL means no upper limit

    -- Who can approve
    approver_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (approver_type IN (
        'user',           -- Specific user
        'role',           -- Anyone with role
        'department_head', -- Head of requestor's department
        'project_manager', -- PM of the related project
        'any_of_group'    -- Any user in a group
    )),
    approver_user_id VARCHAR(255), -- For 'user' type
    approver_role VARCHAR(100),     -- For 'role' type
    approver_group_ids TEXT[],      -- For 'any_of_group' type

    -- Level settings
    is_required BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    can_delegate BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    auto_approve BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    auto_approve_condition TEXT, -- JSON condition for auto-approve

    -- Ordering
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE(workflow_id, level_number)
);

-- ============================================================================
-- APPROVAL REQUESTS
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    workflow_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES approval_workflows(id),
    level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES approval_levels(id),

    -- Document being approved
    document_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    document_id UUID NOT NULL,
    document_number VARCHAR(50),
    document_amount DECIMAL(14,2),

    -- Request details
    requested_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    requested_by_name VARCHAR(255),
    requested_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    request_notes TEXT,

    -- Current assignee
    assigned_to VARCHAR(255),
    assigned_to_name VARCHAR(255),
    assigned_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

    -- Response
    status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN (
        'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'escalated', 'skipped', 'cancelled'
    )),
    responded_by VARCHAR(255),
    responded_by_name VARCHAR(255),
    responded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    response_notes TEXT,

    -- Delegation
    delegated_from VARCHAR(255),
    delegated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    delegation_reason TEXT,

    -- Escalation
    escalated_to VARCHAR(255),
    escalated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    escalation_reason TEXT,

    -- Due date
    due_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    is_overdue BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,

    -- Tracking
    reminder_sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    reminder_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================================================
-- APPROVAL HISTORY
-- ============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approval_history (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    approval_request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES approval_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    -- Action
    action VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (action IN (
        'created', 'assigned', 'viewed', 'approved', 'rejected',
        'escalated', 'delegated', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'reminded'
    )),

    -- Actor
    performed_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    performed_by_name VARCHAR(255),
    performed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),

    -- Details
    from_status VARCHAR(30),
    to_status VARCHAR(30),
    notes TEXT,
    metadata JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================================================
-- INDEXES
-- ============================================================================

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_aw_type ON approval_workflows(workflow_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_aw_active ON approval_workflows(is_active) WHERE is_active = true;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_al_workflow ON approval_levels(workflow_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_al_threshold ON approval_levels(min_amount, max_amount);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_workflow ON approval_requests(workflow_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_level ON approval_requests(level_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_document ON approval_requests(document_type, document_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_status ON approval_requests(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_assigned ON approval_requests(assigned_to);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_requested_by ON approval_requests(requested_by);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_pending ON approval_requests(status, assigned_to) WHERE status = 'pending';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ar_overdue ON approval_requests(is_overdue, status) WHERE is_overdue = true AND status = 'pending';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ah_request ON approval_history(approval_request_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ah_action ON approval_history(action);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ah_performed_by ON approval_history(performed_by);

-- ============================================================================
-- TRIGGER: Auto-update updated_at
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_approval_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS tr_aw_updated_at ON approval_workflows;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_aw_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON approval_workflows
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_approval_updated_at();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS tr_ar_updated_at ON approval_requests;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_ar_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON approval_requests
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_approval_updated_at();

-- ============================================================================
-- FUNCTION: Create approval history entry
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION log_approval_action()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        INSERT INTO approval_history (
            approval_request_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_name,
            to_status, notes
        ) VALUES (
            NEW.id, 'created', NEW.requested_by, NEW.requested_by_name,
            NEW.status, NEW.request_notes
        );
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status <> NEW.status THEN
        INSERT INTO approval_history (
            approval_request_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_name,
            from_status, to_status, notes
        ) VALUES (
            NEW.id,
            CASE NEW.status
                WHEN 'approved' THEN 'approved'
                WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'rejected'
                WHEN 'escalated' THEN 'escalated'
                WHEN 'skipped' THEN 'skipped'
                WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled'
                ELSE 'assigned'
            END,
            COALESCE(NEW.responded_by, NEW.assigned_to, NEW.requested_by),
            COALESCE(NEW.responded_by_name, NEW.assigned_to_name, NEW.requested_by_name),
            OLD.status,
            NEW.status,
            NEW.response_notes
        );
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS tr_ar_history ON approval_requests;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_ar_history
    AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON approval_requests
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION log_approval_action();

-- ============================================================================
-- FUNCTION: Check overdue approvals
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_approval_overdue()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.due_date IS NOT NULL AND NEW.due_date < NOW() AND NEW.status = 'pending' THEN
        NEW.is_overdue := true;
    ELSE
        NEW.is_overdue := false;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS tr_ar_overdue ON approval_requests;
CREATE TRIGGER tr_ar_overdue
    BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON approval_requests
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION check_approval_overdue();

## Procurement Approvals System - Complete Research Report

I've conducted a thorough search of the FibreFlow procurement approval system. Here are the findings:

---

### 1. **Approval Workflow Architecture**

**Database Tables (Migration 052):**
- `approval_workflows` — Defines workflow types (purchase_requisition, purchase_order, boq, rfq, goods_receipt, supplier_registration, payment_request)
- `approval_levels` — Multi-level approval thresholds within workflows (amount-based)
- `approval_requests` — Individual approval instances for documents
- `approval_history` — Audit trail of all approval actions

**Key Configuration:**
- Threshold-based (amount-driven) approval levels
- Support for user-specific, role-based, department head, project manager, and group approvals
- Auto-approval for low-value items
- 48-hour escalation windows with overdue tracking

---

### 2. **How Approvals Are Triggered**

**Primary Trigger Points:**

| Document Type | Trigger Endpoint | File | Threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Purchase Requisition** | `POST /api/procurement/requisitions/[id]/submit` | `/pages/api/procurement/requisitions/[id]/submit.ts` (146 lines) | ≥ R10,000 |
| **Purchase Order** | `PATCH /api/procurement/purchase-orders/[id]` with `action=submit` | `/pages/api/procurement/purchase-orders/[id].ts` | Determined by approval levels in DB |

**Trigger Logic (PR Submit):**
```
1. Check if amount ≥ R10,000 → needs approval
2. If no: auto-approve with status='approved'
3. If yes: find matching approval workflow + level by amount
4. Create approval_requests row with status='pending'
5. Update PR status to 'pending_approval'
```

**Trigger Logic (PO Submit via Service):**
- Call `poApprovalService.submitForApproval(poId, userId, userName)`
- Service queries `approval_levels` for matching threshold
- Creates `approval_requests` with 48-hour due date
- Updates PO status to 'pending_approval'
- Links approval request via `po.current_approval_request_id`

---

### 3. **Approval Decision Endpoints**

| Action | Endpoint | File | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| **View Pending** | `GET /api/procurement/approvals/pending` | `/pages/api/procurement/approvals/pending.ts` (142 lines) | List of `MyApprovalTask[]` filtered by user role/ID |
| **Approve** | `POST /api/procurement/approvals/[id]/approve` | `/pages/api/procurement/approvals/[id]/approve.ts` (162 lines) | Updates approval_requests + document status |
| **Reject** | `POST /api/procurement/approvals/[id]/reject` | `/pages/api/procurement/approvals/[id]/reject.ts` (164 lines) | Rejects + resets document to 'draft' for POs |
| **Check PO Status** | `GET /api/procurement/purchase-orders-approval?poId=xxx` | `/pages/api/procurement/purchase-orders-approval.ts` (129 lines) | Approval status, history, quote comparison |

---

### 4. **Approver Determination**

**Matching Logic (in `poApprovalService.getApprovalLevelForAmount`):**
```typescript
1. Query approval_levels by:
   - workflow_type = 'purchase_order'
   - is_active = true
   - min_amount <= total_amount
   - (max_amount IS NULL OR max_amount > total_amount)
2. Return level with approver_type + approver_user_id/approver_role
```

**Permission Check (`canUserApprove`):**
```
1. Admins (super_admin, admin) → Always can approve
2. Specific user? Check approver_user_id == userId
3. Role-based? Check approver_role == user.role
4. Otherwise → Deny
```

**Default Approval Levels (PO Workflow - Migration 136):**
- **Level 1:** R0 - R5,000 → Auto-approved
- **Level 2:** R5,000 - R50,000 → `procurement_manager` role
- **Level 3:** R50,000+ → `director` role

---

### 5. **Notification System**

**Architecture:**
- Central `notify()` function in `/src/modules/notifications/services/notificationBus.ts` (206 lines)
- Non-blocking, fire-and-forget pattern
- Routes to in-app DB + email/WhatsApp based on user preferences

**Procurement Notification Events (Constants):**
- `procurement.approval_needed` — Sent when approval request created
  - Icon: `file-check`, Severity: `warning`
  - Channels: in-app ✅, email ✅, WhatsApp ❌
  
- `procurement.approved` — Sent after approval
  - Icon: `check-circle`, Severity: `success`
  - Channels: in-app ✅, email ✅, WhatsApp ❌
  
- `procurement.rejected` — Sent after rejection
  - Icon: `x-circle`, Severity: `error`
  - Channels: in-app ✅, email ✅, WhatsApp ❌

**Location:** `/src/modules/notifications/constants/index.ts` (191 lines)

---

### 6. **Current Notification Implementation Gap**

**CRITICAL FINDING:** The approval request creation does NOT trigger notifications yet.

**Evidence:**
- `poApprovalService.submitForApproval()` creates `approval_requests` rows but **does not call `notify()`**
- `/pages/api/procurement/requisitions/[id]/submit.ts` submits PRs without notifications
- **Only approve/reject actions send notifications:**
  - `approve.ts` line 75-84: `notify({ event_type: 'procurement.approved', ... })`
  - `reject.ts` line 78-88: `notify({ event_type: 'procurement.rejected', ... })`

**Missing notification trigger:**
- When approval_requests created → should call `notify({ event_type: 'procurement.approval_needed', recipient_user_ids: [approver_ids] })`
- Currently, approvers have NO notification that an approval is pending

---

### 7. **Data Structures**

**Approval Request Type** (`/src/types/procurement/approval.types.ts`):
```typescript
interface MyApprovalTask {
  id: string;
  documentType: WorkflowType; // purchase_requisition | purchase_order | boq | rfq | goods_receipt
  documentId: string;
  documentNumber?: string;
  documentAmount?: number;
  
  workflowName: string;
  levelName: string;
  levelNumber: number;
  
  requestedBy: string;
  requestedByName?: string;
  requestedAt: string;
  requestNotes?: string;
  
  dueDate?: string;
  isOverdue: boolean;
  reminderCount: number;
  
  canApprove: boolean;
  canReject: boolean;
  canDelegate: boolean; // Not yet implemented
  canEscalate: boolean; // Not yet implemented
}
```

```typescript
  purchase_requisition: {
    displayName: 'Purchase Requisition',
    defaultLevels: [
      { name: 'Auto-approve (Low Value)', minAmount: 0, maxAmount: 10000, approverRole: 'auto' },
      { name: 'Manager Approval', minAmount: 10000, maxAmount: 50000, approverRole: 'manager' },
      { name: 'Director Approval', minAmount: 50000, approverRole: 'director' },

  },

    defaultLevels: [
      { name: 'Manager Approval', minAmount: 0, maxAmount: 25000, approverRole: 'manager' },
      { name: 'Director Approval', minAmount: 25000, maxAmount: 100000, approverRole: 'director' },
      { name: 'Executive Approval', minAmount: 100000, approverRole: 'executive' },
    ],
  },
  // ... 5 more workflow configs

```

| File | Lines | Purpose |
|------|-------|---------|
| `/src/services/procurement/approval/poApprovalService.ts` | 809 | Core PO approval logic: submit, approve, reject, versioning |
| `/src/types/procurement/approval.types.ts` | 416 | Complete type definitions for workflows, requests, history |

| `/pages/api/procurement/approvals/[id]/reject.ts` | 164 | Reject an approval request + revert document to draft + notify requester |

### 9. **Approval Status Workflow**

```
draft → [SUBMIT] → pending_approval → [APPROVE] → approved → [SEND] → sent
                  ↓
                [REJECT] → draft (version + 1)

For POs specifically:
- submitted_at: When approval_requests created
- due_date: NOW() + 48 hours
- is_overdue: Trigger checks if due_date < NOW()
- Version increments on each rejection (purchase_order_versions table)
```
